before: 孩子们在公园里玩捉迷藏，笑声不断。
after: 孩子们拿着小网兜在花丛中捉蝴蝶，玩得可开心了。
why: 捉迷藏 is a fixed compound and not the "to catch" sense; use 捉 as a free verb

before: The children were playing hide-and-seek in the park, laughing nonstop.
after: The children were catching butterflies among the flowers with little nets, having a great time.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 他骑车时没看清路，连人带车掉进了路旁的水沟里。
after: 他骑车时没看清路，连人带车掉进了路旁的沟里。
why: hanzi was inside the compound 水沟; use 沟 on its own

before: 这件事你先别急着做决定，过后我们再慢慢商量。
after: 暴风雨过后，天边出现了一道美丽的彩虹。
why: 以后/之后 fit 过后我们再商量 equally; N+过后 is the characteristic use

before: Don't rush to decide on this now; we can talk it over later.
after: After the storm, a beautiful rainbow appeared in the sky.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 一百万对普通家庭来说可不是个小数目。
after: 请你把箱子里的东西数一数，看看数目对不对。
why: moved the counting sentence to the example; 数字 fits it as well as 数目, so it is weak as a quiz

before: A million is no small sum for an ordinary family.
after: Please count the things in the box and see if the number is right.
why: match new example sentence

before: 请你把箱子里的东西数一数，看看数目对不对。
after: 五十万对刚工作的年轻人来说，可不是一笔小数目。
why: use the fixed collocation 一笔小数目, which only 数目 completes

before: Please count the things in the box and see if the number is right.
after: Half a million is no small sum for a young person just starting work.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 他捡起地上的一根棍子，把挡路的树枝拨开了。
after: 他从地上捡起一根棍，把挡在路中间的树枝拨开了。
why: blanking 棍 inside 棍子 gives away the answer; use 棍 on its own

before: 孩子们趴在栏杆上看河里的小鸭子。
after: 报名表上的“特长”一栏，他想了半天也不知道该填什么。
why: hanzi was inside the compound 栏杆; use 栏 on its own (一栏)

before: The children leaned on the railing to watch the ducklings in the river.
after: He thought for ages about the "special skills" field on the application form but had no idea what to write.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 他最近总在躲避我，打电话也不接。
after: 听到警报声后，居民们迅速躲避到附近的地下室里。
why: 回避/逃避 fit 总在躲避我 equally; physical sheltering points to 躲避

before: He's been avoiding me lately; he won't even answer my calls.
after: When they heard the siren, residents quickly took shelter in a nearby basement.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 禁止从窗户往外扔任何物体，以免砸伤楼下的行人。
after: 物体从高处落下时，速度会越来越快。
why: natural Chinese says 扔东西/物品 out of a window, not 物体; 物体 belongs to the physical-science register

before: Throwing any object out of the window is forbidden, so as not to hurt people walking below.
after: When an object falls from a height, it falls faster and faster.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 人生就像一段旅程，重要的不是终点，而是沿途的风景。
after: 这次自驾游的旅程全长两千多公里，一路经过五个省。
why: 旅途 (same batch, same first character) fits 人生就像一段旅程 equally; 全长 rules it out

before: Life is like a journey: what matters isn't the destination but the scenery along the way.
after: This road trip covers more than 2,000 kilometres and passes through five provinces.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 这家博物馆不收取门票，所有人都可以免费参观。
after: 这家博物馆不收取任何费用，所有人都可以免费参观。
why: 收取 takes 费用, not 门票 (不收取门票 is a mis-collocation)

before: This museum charges no admission; everyone can visit for free.
after: This museum charges no fees at all; everyone can visit for free.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 这个路口安装了摄像头，闯红灯会被拍下来。
after: 这次活动由小王负责摄像，小李负责拍照。
why: hanzi was inside the noun 摄像头; use the verb sense

before: Cameras have been installed at this intersection; running a red light will be caught on camera.
after: At this event Xiao Wang is in charge of filming and Xiao Li of taking photos.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 猫头鹰白天睡觉，晚上出来捕食老鼠。
after: 这次出海，渔民们捕到了一条两米多长的大鱼。
why: 捕食 is a separate compound; use 捕 as a free verb (捕到)

before: Owls sleep during the day and come out at night to hunt mice.
after: On this trip out to sea, the fishermen caught a fish over two metres long.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 他从小就喜欢搜集各个国家的邮票。
after: 出发前，我在网上搜集了很多关于这座城市的旅游信息。
why: stamps are normally 收集 (a likely distractor), not 搜集; searching for information favours 搜集

before: Since childhood he has loved collecting stamps from all over the world.
after: Before setting off, I gathered lots of travel information about the city online.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 自从吵过那一架，他们俩就再也没有来往过。
after: 妈妈不许我跟那些不三不四的人来往。
why: 往来 (same batch) fits 再也没有来往过 too; colloquial 跟…来往 favours 来往

before: Since that quarrel, the two of them have had nothing to do with each other.
after: Mum won't let me hang around with those shady characters.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 每种动物都有自己的特性，比如猫喜欢在夜里活动。
after: 每种金属都有自己的特性，比如铜的导电性特别好。
why: an animal's night-time habits are 习性, not 特性

before: Every animal has its own traits; cats, for example, like to be active at night.
after: Every metal has its own properties; copper, for example, conducts electricity especially well.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 适当做做眼保健操，可以缓解眼睛疲劳。
after: 人上了年纪，就要更加重视日常的保健。
why: hanzi was inside the fixed compound 眼保健操; use 保健 on its own

before: Doing some eye exercises now and then can relieve eye strain.
after: As people get older, they need to pay more attention to everyday health care.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 多读书可以扩展我们的知识面。
after: 安装了这个插件以后，软件就能扩展出很多新功能。
why: 知识面 collocates with 扩大/拓宽 (扩大 is a likely distractor); 扩展功能 is the natural pairing

before: Reading more can broaden our knowledge.
after: Once you install this plug-in, the software can be extended with lots of new features.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 这位画家后期的作品风格发生了很大变化。
after: 比赛进入后期，双方队员的体力都明显下降了。
why: 前期 (same batch) fit 画家后期的作品 equally; falling stamina points to the late stage

before: The style of this painter's later works changed a great deal.
after: As the match entered its later stage, players on both sides were visibly tiring.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: This fish is brightly coloured and is prized as an ornamental fish.
after: This fish is brightly coloured and has great ornamental value.
why: "prized as an ornamental fish" did not render 很有观赏价值 faithfully

before: 父母为了把我们养大，付出了很多艰辛。
after: 他历尽艰辛，终于找到了失散多年的妹妹。
why: 付出了很多艰辛 is an awkward collocation; 历尽艰辛 is the standard one

before: Our parents went through great hardship to raise us.
after: After going through countless hardships, he finally found the sister he had lost touch with for years.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 他在当地没有任何亲属，只能一个人生活。
after: 这项手续只能由本人或者直系亲属代为办理。
why: 亲戚/亲人 is more natural in 当地没有任何亲属; formal 直系亲属 requires 亲属

before: He has no relatives there and has to live on his own.
after: This procedure can only be handled by the person themselves or an immediate family member.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 停电的时候，医院会自动启用备用发电机。
after: 这座大坝建成以后，每年可以发电几十亿度。
why: hanzi was inside the noun 发电机; use the verb sense

before: When there's a power cut, the hospital automatically switches to its backup generator.
after: Once built, this dam will be able to generate billions of kilowatt-hours of electricity a year.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 这种病前期症状不明显，很多人没有及时发现。
after: 这个项目前期投入很大，要两三年以后才能赚钱。
why: the medical term is 早期症状, not 前期症状; 前期投入 is the standard collocation

before: This disease has no obvious symptoms in its early stage, so many people don't catch it in time.
after: This project needs heavy investment in its early stage and will take two or three years to turn a profit.
why: match new quiz sentence

before: 我妈妈有两个妹妹，我叫她们大姨和小姨。
after: 我妈妈有两个姐姐，我叫她们大姨和二姨。
why: mother's younger sisters are not called 大姨 (大姨 is her eldest sister)

before: My mother has two younger sisters; I call them Big Auntie and Little Auntie.
after: My mother has two older sisters; I call them Big Auntie and Second Auntie.
why: match new example sentence

before: 今年前十个月，入境旅游人数比去年增长了两成。
after: 飞机降落以后，乘客要先排队办理入境手续。
why: 出境 (same batch) fit 入境旅游人数 equally; landing points to 入境

before: In the first ten months of this year, the number of inbound tourists rose by twenty percent over last year.
after: After the plane lands, passengers first queue to go through entry formalities.
why: match new quiz sentence
